intro.en: AI agent engineer and M.S. in Information student at the University of Michigan, building reliable LLM agents, agent harnesses, and the data pipelines behind them.
intro.zh: 密歇根大学信息科学硕士在读，专注 AI Agent 研发：打造可靠的大模型 Agent、Agent Harness 及其背后的数据流水线。

about.en: I am a Master of Science in Information student at the University of Michigan School of Information. I received my B.Eng. in Electrical and Computer Engineering from Shanghai Jiao Tong University, with minors in Computer Science and Data Science.
about.zh: 我目前在密歇根大学信息学院攻读信息科学硕士。本科毕业于上海交通大学电子与计算机工程专业，获工学学士学位，并辅修计算机科学与数据科学。

about.en: My work centers on AI agents: a conversational data-analysis agent at Tencent, a code-agent harness at Salesforce, and a multimodal data engine for Computer Use agents at OpenAGI Foundation. I am also a co-author of the OSGym paper and of a study evaluating SAM2 for surgical video analysis.
about.zh: 我的工作聚焦于 AI Agent：在腾讯开发对话式取数 Agent，在 Salesforce 开发代码 Agent Harness，在 OpenAGI Foundation 为 Computer Use Agent 构建多模态数据引擎。我也以共同作者身份参与了 OSGym 论文和 SAM2 手术视频分析评测研究。

about.en: I enjoy turning messy real-world problems into dependable systems and sharing what I learn through workshops and open-source projects. Beyond work, I have a deep love for football and a passion for traveling and photography.
about.zh: 我喜欢把复杂的现实问题变成可靠的系统，也乐于通过技术分享会和开源项目分享所学。工作之外，我热爱足球，也喜欢旅行和摄影。
